testimonials.t1_text: Excellent service! We requested a nursing visit for my father post-surgery. The nurse arrived right on time and was extremely professional.

faq.heading: Answers to Your Most Common Questions
faq.q1: How can I book a home medical visit?
faq.a1: Choose the required service from our website, select the date, time, and city, or click "Request Callback" and our team will contact you immediately to confirm the booking.
faq.q2: Is the medical staff officially licensed?
faq.a2: Yes, all our doctors, nurses, and specialists hold valid licenses from the Saudi Health Specialties Commission.
faq.q3: Which cities do your services cover?
faq.a3: We currently cover the entire city of Jeddah and all its neighborhoods, and we are working on expanding soon.
faq.q4: How do I receive my lab test results?
faq.a4: Results are sent electronically as an encrypted PDF to your account, email, and WhatsApp immediately upon completion.
